title: Keys recover sequence items on support
statement: Let a target Boolean function, a family of learning programs indexed by a type, and a key function from outputs to that index type be given. Suppose that for each index, every output-and-cost pair in the support of the corresponding program's outcome law has output whose key equals that index. Then every outcome-and-cost pair in the support of the law for running the sequence of programs indexed by a finite list has an output list whose keys, in order, equal that list.
hypotheses_covered: A family of learning programs indexed by a type
A key function from outputs to the index type
For every index, supported outcomes of its program have output key equal to that index
An outcome-and-cost pair in the support of the sequence's outcome law
